'''2014 Worlds Reset Beta Marvin Tegeler LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Marvin Tegeler]] at [[2014 World Championship Reset Beta]].

* '''Player:''' [[Marvin Tegeler]]
* '''Event:''' [[2014 World Championship Reset Beta]]
